annotations.title: Maximum offer at a target cap rate

description: Most to pay for a rental so its NOI earns a target cap rate: NOI divided by the target, less the repairs and purchase costs the deal needs, with a floor of 0. Working backward from a cap rate is where offers go wrong, because the value at the target cap rate still has to pay for repairs and closing costs before it becomes a price. Send the stabilized yearly noi and target_cap_pct (8 means 8%); optionally repairs and purchase_costs. A negative NOI gives a maximum price of 0 with a flag.

purchase_costs.description: Closing, inspection and other purchase costs, e.g. 4000

target_cap_pct.description: Target cap rate in percent, e.g. 8

name: compute_max_offer_at_cap_rate
